issue_text: Both the production comment (reviewlog.go:240-242) and the test comment (reviewlog_test.go:480-484) assert that TestLensErasAreKeyedByDate enforces the 'cut a new frozen vNLenses snapshot and append an era' step: 'growing lens.All (and with it currentLenses) without cutting a new frozen snapshot and era would make eraLenses("mrv-20260831-…") return more than nine and fail here' / 'TestLensErasAreKeyedByDate pins each era against its frozen literal so skipping that step fails.' That enforcement does not exist. eraLenses() returns only entries of lensEras, whose .lenses fields are the FROZEN literals (legacyLenses/v08Lenses/v09Lenses) — never currentLenses/lens.All. The test's want values are those same frozen literals (e.g. line 485 {"mrv-20260831-…", v09Lenses}). Adding a lens to lens.All changes currentLenses (via currentLensKeys) but leaves lensEras and eraLenses output completely unchanged, so TestLensErasAreKeyedByDate is invariant to lens.All growth and CANNOT fail when the era-cut step is skipped. Consequence: adding a lens to lens.All has zero gating effect for any review that falls back to the era floor (declares no 'Required lenses:' marker) — a post-addition undeclared review is still only required to cover the stale newest-era set — and no test in the repo fails to remind the developer to cut the era.
